suppress.notes: False positive. CVE-2018-1258 affects Spring Framework 5.0.5 used together with any Spring Security version (authorization bypass with method security). NVD therefore lists cpe:...:spring_security:* for every version, so Dependency-Check flags all Spring Security jars. This project uses Spring Framework 7.0.x (spring-core 7.0.10) with Spring Security 7.1.x, which is not affected. Scoped to this CVE and to Spring Security artifacts only; remove when the backend no longer uses them or NVD narrows the CPE. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2018-1258
Same CVE-2018-1258 false positive as above, matched by file name for the copies nested in the Spring Boot jar (BOOT-INF/lib) in case the scanner reports them without a package URL.
